title: Prepositions for Location, Time and Method
objective: Students use prepositions accurately in laboratory and research descriptions.
context: Field note: The leaf was ___ the table. We looked at it ___ a hand lens. We wrote notes ___ the visit.

items.prompt: Choose a word that shows the item rested on the surface. Write the sentence.
items.answer: The leaf was on the table.
items.hint: Think about where the item was.

items.prompt: Choose a word that introduces the tool.
items.answer: With: We looked at it with a hand lens.

items.prompt: Complete the last sentence to show that notes were written while the visit was happening.
items.answer: We wrote notes during the visit.
items.hint: Choose a word that means “while something happens”.
